about.name: I'm Lara
about.bio:
a native Italian teacher and language enthusiast, 

My love for languages has taken me to study, live, and work abroad, from the UK to Russia. Along the way, I've experienced all the ups and downs of learning a foreign language myself: the excitement of your first real conversation, the frustration of forgetting the simplest word, and that amazing feeling when everything finally clicks.

Since 2022, I've been helping students from all over the world build confidence and speak Italian in real-life situations. My lessons are interactive, practical, and relaxed, because making mistakes is part of the journey and speaking is how you improve.

Behind every lesson is a solid academic background in languages and interpreting, along with the DILS-PG Level II certification for teaching Italian as a foreign language. 

What matters most to me is creating lessons you'll actually enjoy and leave feeling more confident than when you joined.

results.title: What You Can Achieve
results.beginner: **Starting from zero?** In few months you'll be able to handle many everyday situations, ask directions, express needs, desires and simple opinions.
results.intermediate: **Already have a good level of Italian?** You’ll expand your vocabulary, explore more complex and specialised topics, and learn to express your ideas with greater accuracy, confidence, and naturalness.

items.name: Francois
items.text: Lara is an excellent Italian teacher. Her lessons are well prepared, engaging, and always enjoyable. She is patient, encouraging, and creates a great learning atmosphere. Thanks to her, I’ve made great progress in Italian and feel much more confident speaking it. I highly recommend her.

items.name: Savva
items.text: I found Lara through an online platform for finding Italian language tutors. What impressed me most was that she has a professional academic background in teaching Russian—my native language—and is also a qualified language teacher. At the same time, Italian, the language I'm learning, is her native language, so she has an excellent understanding of all its nuances and, most importantly, knows how to explain them clearly in Russian. I have been taking online lessons with Lara once a week for almost two years. During this time, my Italian has improved significantly, and now I can communicate confidently on a wide variety of topics. Of course, I continue learning because no language can be mastered completely in a short time, and there is always room for improvement. Lara puts a great deal of care into preparing each lesson. She creates personalized classes with elements of gamification, so learning is always engaging and never boring. During our lessons, we work on grammar, speaking, and listening skills, while I complete writing exercises as homework. I highly recommend Lara as an excellent teacher who will help you start speaking Italian accurately and confidently. She corrects mistakes patiently, is always supportive, and creates a comfortable learning environment where you can improve without feeling stressed. I’m very happy that I chose to learn Italian with Lara. I wish you the best of luck on your language-learning journey!
